title: slot_for accepts non-integer num_slots and can return a float slot index
description: Correctness/type-contract review of python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py found slot_for only checks num_slots <= 0. A value such as 2.5 passes validation and Python modulo returns a float, violating the declared int return and producing an invalid TDMA slot index; True is also accepted as one slot. Enforce an exact positive integer num_slots (excluding bool), document the chosen unsigned-32 SFN normalization contract, and add invalid-type boundary tests independent of the generator oracle.
notes: Implemented exact-int validation for num_slots and SFN, documented u32 normalization, added bool/float/string/None boundary tests. Awaiting 3x review; do not close yet.
